proposal.analysis: The nearest foil is the two-part bow-tie-like figure: it shares the elongated quadrilateral, curved sector, closed contours, convexity, and single-point attachment. The smallest robust difference is alignment. In the target configuration, rays from the junction toward the two component centers form a visibly bent angle, roughly 115–170 degrees; in the foil they are nearly collinear, around 180 degrees. A second local expression is the unequal pair of empty angular gaps around the junction: one broad gap and one narrow gap.
